authority_basis: Explicit human operator trust/procurement preference. This policy does not assert misconduct, poisoning, or wrongdoing as established fact.
prohibited_for_garden_work: indirect routing through aggregators or fallbacks to excluded provider endpoints
use of models published or controlled by an excluded organization, including third-party-hosted routes
assignment as reviewer, challenger, adjudicator, research agent, or synthesis agent
requesting review, advice, collaboration, support, or other active contact from an excluded organization
automatic or manual fallback to an excluded organization when another provider fails
allowed_non_operational_uses: preserving historical repository records and prior-art citations
mentioning an excluded organization when necessary for audit, provenance, incident analysis, or policy explanation
using independently sourced public evidence about an excluded organization without contacting or routing Garden work to it
architecture_effect: No Garden semantic owner, authority source, truth source, or top-level engine is created. This is an operator/vendor routing constraint.
